features.name: Per Diem Allowance Calculation
features.description: Automated calculation of per diem allowances based on multiple methods including 24-hour rolling periods, full calendar days, and partial day rules with flexible percentage or hour-based configurations.
caveats: Calculation rules vary significantly by country
Requires setup to be compliant with local regulations

features.name: Expense Agent Wizard Configuration
features.description: Guided wizard interface to configure per diem calculation and meal reduction settings, with option to adjust detailed configuration in expense agent setup for full country rule compliance.

features.name: Itinerary Detection and Classification
features.description: The agent automatically detects when an expense is provided as an itinerary and categorizes it as a per diem expense, extracting travel details and dates from the itinerary document.

features.name: Automatic Location Detection
features.description: The expense agent seamlessly detects travel destinations and locations from itinerary expenses, mapping them to configured business central locations based on where the employee spent most days.
caveats: Location detection depends on itinerary data provided

features.name: Meal Reduction Configuration and Application
features.description: Users can mark meals received during a trip and the system automatically applies configured percentage reductions to per diem allowances. Admins set up meal reduction percentages in the per diem details tab.
caveats: Meal reductions are company policy driven

features.name: Per Diem Trip Period Detection
features.description: The system automatically detects and records the start and end times of per diem trips from itinerary expenses, capturing complete travel periods including outbound and return journeys.

features.name: Per Diem Expense Web Application
features.description: Web application interface for expense agent where users can submit and edit per diem expenses, view detected itinerary data, locations, dates, and apply meal reductions.

features.name: Per Diem Admin Settings Tab
features.description: Business Central admin section with dedicated per diem details tab in expense agent wizard where administrators configure calculation method, flat rates, and meal reduction percentages.
